Path 3, compositionGOALS §10.1

Crossplane

Cloud resources and app infrastructure as Kubernetes APIs we define.

WHAT IT IS

A CNCF Graduated control plane: providers manage cloud resources; compositions and functions turn them into our own typed APIs. v2 lets compositions include plain Kubernetes resources.

WHAT SETS IT APART

Multi-cloud managed resources plus a function pipeline for platform logic. Versus Terraform: continuous reconciliation. Versus kro: kro composes but doesn't manage cloud resources, and now runs inside Crossplane.

WHERE WE STAND

Trial, starting with S3, aiming at the app layer. We already contribute to function-lifecycle.

Crossplane Contribfest (Upbound); "What Changes When Crossplane Adoption Gets Real" (American Family), KubeCon NA 2026

TRIAL

Crossplane: Cloud resources and app infrastructure as Kubernetes APIs we define. Where we stand: Trial, starting with S3, aiming at the app layer. We already contribute to function-lifecycle. The real decision is the CDK-to-Crossplane seam: decision 3.
